pedagogical_frameworks.name: Productive Failure
pedagogical_frameworks.description: Students who attempt problems before receiving instruction show 20-40% better retention than those receiving direct instruction first.
pedagogical_frameworks.implementation: XP Engine branches deliberately include 'wrong' paths that provide memorable correction scenes.

pedagogical_frameworks.name: Spaced Retrieval Practice
pedagogical_frameworks.description: Spacing out retrieval attempts across time significantly improves long-term retention.
pedagogical_frameworks.implementation: Concept revisitation is spaced across narrative nodes with varied context.

pedagogical_frameworks.name: Narrative Transport Theory
pedagogical_frameworks.description: Embedding information within compelling narratives increases absorption and reduces resistance.
pedagogical_frameworks.implementation: Academic concepts are wrapped in historical and fictional narratives.
